rag.text:
Test: TC-5157 — SPM - Workday - Synchronizing Archived Resources
Priority: High | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-505 Workday
Labels: spm-paulina-tc, teamace

Description:
In order to execute this test, first execute Workday Integration [https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|https://appfire.atlassian.net/browse/TC-5064|smart-link]

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals list is displayed

Following buttons are displayed at the top-right:

* Refresh Workday absences
* Synchronize with Tempo
* Assign To
* Add new Individual
2. Click on three dots on Full Name column, type userName1 and select
   Data: userName: kamil.koszarny
   Expected: User Kamil Koszarny is selected
3. Click on Archive resources button next to userName
   Data: userName: kamil.koszarny
   Expected: Confirmation message is displayed

‘After archiving, this resource's capacity will be zero, and team’s availability will be set as Unavailable from the archive date. You can restore it anytime, but team availability must be manually adjusted.’ 

Archive and Cancel buttons are displayed
4. Click Archive
   Expected: User Kamil Koszarny disappeared from the list
5. Click on Three dots next to Archived column
   Expected: Two options are displayed in filer menu:

* Empty Value
* Archived
6. Click Archived
   Expected: Option Archvied is selected. 

User Kamil Koszarny is visible on the list again
7. Click on Refresh Workday absences
   Expected: Refresh Workday absences button is gray and has a loading icon

In the left corner there’s blue message

'Synchronization with Workday in progress

The synchronization of absences from Workday is currently in progress. We will notify you once it has been completed'

After few seconds, green message is displayed ‘Synchronization with Workday finished’



Workday sync column appeared but Kamil Koszarny has no synced status
8. Click on useName
   Data: userName: kamil.koszarny
   Expected: User Kamil Koszarny has Archived label

User is not synchronized with Workday
